local.en: But the food of ordinary people continued to be based on local ingredients and traditional recipes By the 18th century, some British writers were already complaining about this trend, criticizing wealthy British people who preferred French cooks to English ones.
local.zh: 但普通人的食物继续以本地食材和传统食谱为基础。到了18世纪，一些英国作家已经开始抱怨这种趋势，批评那些宁愿要法国厨师也不要英国厨师的富有英国人。

local.en: There are long waiting lists to ensure that a new customer won't overload the local network, and in some parts of the United States, these waiting lists stretch to eight years, which is eight years too long if you're a technology company racing to build the next generation of AI.
local.zh: 排队等待的名单很长，以确保新客户不会使当地网络过载，而在美国某些地区，排队时间长达八年，对于一家竞相开发下一代人工智能的科技公司来说，八年实在太漫长了。
